intro.text:
How to read this canvas

Every screen is a web page designed at laptop width (1440px), built from the Carona design system's real components. Pages are fluid, so they also work in a narrow window.

Press Play on any page to click through: the top navigation and the main links move between pages.

Rows 1 and 2 work against the API as it is today. Rows 3 and 4 need the rides and bookings endpoints from the roadmap.

The note under each page names its endpoint and what the code must handle. Every page has a Theme tweak to check dark mode.

n-add-vehicle.text:
Works today · POST /vehicles/
400 "Vehicle already exists" means the plate is taken: show it on the plate field. Capacity has no limits in the API yet; the form allows 1–8.

n-booked.text:
Planned · booking response
The plate number and car colour appear only after booking. Cash at pickup is the default for now.

n-driver.text:
Planned · GET /rides/{id}/bookings, PATCH /rides/{id}/status
Start trip appears from 30 minutes before departure. Cancelling asks for confirmation and cancels every booking.

n-edit-vehicle.text:
Blocked · PATCH /vehicles/{id}
Fails with a 500 until the argument order in routes/vehicles.py is fixed, and needs every field until VehicleUpdate makes them optional. Send only changed fields. There is no DELETE yet, so no Remove button.

n-find.text:
Planned · GET /rides?origin=&destination=&date=
Places are free text for now. Recent searches live in the browser (localStorage), not the API.

n-offer.text:
Planned · POST /rides
Vehicle picker uses GET /vehicles/ (works today). Seats are capped at the vehicle's capacity. distance_km is left out until maps arrive. In Play, the preview card follows the fare and seats you type.

n-offer-none.text:
Works today · GET /vehicles/ returns []
Driving needs a vehicle, so Offer a ride asks for one first. This is the "driver is a capability, not a role" decision from the brief.

n-profile.text:
Works today · GET /users/me
Show name, email and phone. Never show role, password or ids. Sign out clears the token; there is no logout endpoint.
Edit details opens Edit profile.

n-register.text:
Works today · POST /users/register
Fields mirror UserCreate: names 2–100 chars, password 6+. Phone is optional. On success, sign in straight away with the same email and password so the person doesn't type them twice.

n-register-err.text:
Works today · 400 and 422
400 "A user with this email already exists" → form Alert with a Sign in link.
422 → one error per field, read from detail[].loc.

n-results.text:
Planned · same endpoint
Each ride must include seats_left, driver {first_name, last_name} and vehicle {make, model, colour} so the list needs one request. Sorted by departure time.

n-results-empty.text:
Planned · data: []
Offer to change the search. Don't show an error: nothing went wrong.

n-ride-detail.text:
Planned · GET /rides/{id}, POST /rides/{id}/bookings
The seat stepper works in Play: the total updates with the seat count. If seats ran out meanwhile, reload the ride and lower the maximum.

n-signin.text:
Works today · POST /users/login
Save data.access_token, then GET /users/me. Both "account does not exist" and "Incorrect password" show the same message so the page doesn't reveal who has an account.

n-topnav.text: One file, imported by every page with <dc-import name="TopNav">. Props: active (find, trips, offer, profile) and signed-in. Change it here and every page follows.

n-trips.text:
Planned · GET /bookings/me and GET /rides/mine
Upcoming first, then past. Shows rides you booked and rides you drive, with a badge for each state.

n-vehicles.text:
Works today · GET /vehicles/
Returns only the signed-in user's vehicles. Capacity is shown as passenger seats.

n-vehicles-empty.text:
Works today · empty list
data: [] → EmptyState with one action.

n-vehicles-loading.text:
Works today · loading
Skeleton cards in the same grid while GET /vehicles/ runs. The header never disappears.

n-welcome.text:
Works today · no API call
Shown when there is no saved token. If a token exists, call GET /users/me: 200 goes to Find a ride, 401 stays here. The ride cards are labelled examples.

row1.text: Get started · works with the API today

row2.text: Profile and vehicles · works today (edit needs the PATCH fix)

row3.text: Find and book · needs the rides and bookings API

row4.text: Trips and offering a ride · needs the rides and bookings API

n-edit-profile.text:
Planned · PATCH /users/me (doesn't exist yet)
Editable: first name, last name, phone. Email can't be changed: leave it out of UserUpdate so the API rejects or ignores it too, not just the form. Every field optional; phone keeps register's uniqueness check (400 → show it on the field). Send only changed fields, then reload GET /users/me. Changing the password is a separate flow, not designed yet.
